sources.title: tetracta/tetracta-znext-1b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a 1B-parameter model trained on 10B tokens. It hallucinates heavily and in a manner appropriate to that scale (see Limitations). There is no safety tuning, no RLHF, and no content filtering beyond what the pre-training corpus implies. Out of scope. Non-English use.

sources.title: Z-Next — a 1B language model with no attention and a ... - tetracta.ai
sources.snippet: Z-Next is a 947M-parameter language model trained on 10.00B tokens with no attention and no KV cache. Its per-session state is 5.227 MiB and does not grow with context. Full benchmark tables, fairness gates, measured concurrency economics, a live demo — and an honest limitations section.
